notes: Auto Live now finds a scheduled premiere on the channel's home page hours ahead, so the Facebook announcement goes out on time, and catches the start of the countdown within seconds instead of a minute or more.

Auto Live now looks for the YouTube premiere announcement up to 6 hours before each scheduled time. When the channel schedules the episode, you get a Telegram message with its time, the thumbnail and start time (in Cuban time) are posted on your Facebook Page, and if the premiere starts earlier than your scheduled time, Auto Live starts watching 10 minutes before it. The post text can be edited in Auto Live.

Streams survive short Internet slowdowns: ReCast now buffers about 10 seconds of video on the way to Facebook instead of cutting the live after half a second. The upload speed is written to the log every minute, with a warning when it drops, and the messages after a connection drop are clearer.
The update window is now always in English.

Daily check at 6:00 PM with a Telegram report (permissions, keychain, Pages and tokens, Auto Live). Auto Live follows a stream started by hand without opening another player or moving the capture, and reuses the player when retrying. Player windows are closed, moved and brought to the front through the Chrome that owns them. Telegram alert if the stream goes 30 seconds without audio.

First version with automatic updates (Sparkle). New identifier com.trinitycommerce.recast; preferences and secrets carry over automatically. macOS will ask again for Screen Recording, Microphone and Apple Events access.
